card.name: Punctuation and digits before page or time numbers
card.fires_on: Punctuation or a digit just before a number is expected, such as the period after an abbreviated source name (Strab.), a comma before pp., or a digit inside a dose or clock time.

modes.label: Citation punctuation
modes.description: A period, comma or opening bracket after an author or journal abbreviation, right before a page or volume number.

modes.label: Digits in numbers
modes.description: A digit within a clock time or dose amount, where more digits or a unit come next.

card.plain: It fires on small punctuation marks and digits that come right before a page number, time or dose amount.
